snippet.title: ASCENDANT | Convoyer Trials Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
💥 Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/YouTubeASCENDANT
The more players sign up, the more goodies are unlocked for everyone. Exclusive in-game decals, badges, and more. Your sign-up and sharing it directly powers the rewards for the whole crew!

More Useful Links:

🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/3YV8putpyu
🔗 Twitter: https://twitter.com/AscendantGame
🔗 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@ascendantgame
🔗 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ascendantgame/
🔗 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AscendantGame

High stakes, high chaos, and the most unpredictable twist on capture-the-flag yet. Outwit rival squads, face mutant wildlife, and secure three biocores in this fast-paced, squad-based FPS where wild events can turn the tables in an ever-shifting BioPunk arena. This is ASCENDANT - bring backup.
